home.hero_text: Root to Rise Recovery Cafe is a welcoming, judgment-free community for people in recovery, their families, and anyone looking for a fresh start. Find benefits you may qualify for, local help, and people who understand.
home.mission: Inspiration Is Everywhere and Root to Rise Recovery Cafe exist to plant hope where it is needed most. We connect people in recovery with community, practical resources, and a place to belong—because recovery grows best when no one does it alone.
home.ma_text: Serving Falmouth, Mashpee, and neighboring Upper Cape towns.
home.nh_text: Serving Nashua and surrounding Southern New Hampshire communities.
